body:
Birth-chart edits could leave obsolete output and chart-linked prompts visible, while delayed calculation, share, save and focus work could attach to newer input. Bind results and later presentation work to their current input, run and applicable access. Clearing a chart now also invalidates the daily panel and chart-triggered email capture, preserving typed fields and unrelated captures.

The correction distinguishes an unread session cache from an observed signed-out session. A profile refresh can no longer overtake a pending session read and incorrectly show device-only state. Explicit sign-out stays authoritative. Already-submitted saves, subscriptions and resends still complete once; no cancellation, retry or provider authority change is introduced. Same-chart email edits made during a pending successful submission retain the existing reset behavior and are not claimed solved.

Reviewable source scope: four product files, six scoped test/driver files, and two four-line native CI steps. Numerical statements, SDK/API/auth provider/account formats, styles/navigation, locale copy, canonical Registry/disclosures and Astrofolio sources are unchanged. Historical date membership and whole-date certainty are separate work. Stacked on #431 at abcf1a44e52040db79a369b49bc9b55d78099b22; current source is 3845a04bcea822da3c30a18848ef3d8d133b7b66.

Validation:
- Root normal build and check pass: 1,043 files, zero errors/warnings. All 4,969 tests in 416 files pass.
- The fixture-enabled full-page gate passes 294/294; the new native gate passes 21/21. Existing chart ownership passes 17/17 and normal feature-off EN/RU desktop/mobile edit/recovery passes 4/4.
- All 18 fresh approved-page captures are byte-identical to the preceding c7b9eb4 source. Existing bundle budgets pass; engine remains 23.3KB/25KB. Earlier macOS chart baseline-height failures and the one scored reduced-motion pixel remain explicitly recorded; no baseline, mask or tolerance changed.
- Independent corrected downstream review passes 25 controller criteria and retains the unchanged email enhancement's 20/20 result by exact-source parity. Original ChartCalculator review separately passed 22 component, 18 native save/profile, five production-build and 17 driver portability controls.
- Original c7b9eb4 CI34209606308 passed 13 jobs and failed one post-chart assertion. The obsolete assertion and real cached-panel defect led to this follow-up. Its first freeze was then rejected for the independently reproduced session-cache race; those failures and original raw evidence remain inspectable. Current-source hosted CI and preview are pending and are not substituted by earlier successful preview evidence.

Durable records: docs/platform/STATUS.md and docs/platform/evidence/{chart-result-ownership,post-chart-clear}/. Author/native fixtures use explicit synthetic account and intercepted response boundaries; they establish presentation ownership, not backend enforcement or provider delivery.

Draft only. No merge, npm publication, production deployment, human numerical/legal signoff or external adoption. SDK #5's explicit hold and the separate Astrofolio verification release remain intact. Scheduled Registry-only updates on latest main remain untouched and must be preserved during eventual integration.
title: Prevent obsolete birth-chart results and delayed action updates
